answer: Proposal: capped endorsement slots. Each answer needs endorser signatures covering ≥S locked stake; the contract caps each token at 3 endorsements per epoch and counts them itself — capacity tough as jade: clones cannot mint slots, only lock more stake. A duplicate oracle (raven) fuzzy-hashes answers pairwise and slashes both endorsers' bonds on a match. The onyx core is the bond: locked, public, forfeitable. Cost: n clones need ~n·S/3 staked — linear; sybil pays only if per-answer reward beats lock-up cost. Leak: paraphrase or a captured raven evades slashing.
